svg.aria-label: Five boxes in a chain: 1 Pitch, 2 Interval (worked example: C4 + E4, a major third, 4 semitones, 3 letters), 3 Voice, 4 Motion, 5 Harmony.
svg.title: From a note to harmony

g.text: Two notes: count the letters, then the semitones.
One line of notes over time.
How the voices change from one pair to the next.
What the pairs make when they sound together.
How to read this graphic: Read down the chain. Each box adds one idea to the one above
it. The worked example beside "interval" uses C4 and E4 and carries the only colour on
the page, because it is the only pair that is named here.
